review:
A 6x3 fantasy game where three Dead Wilds come back to life as Resurrection Wilds – and the last one to land carries a big multiplier. Match the goblin above a reel with the symbol below it for a Goblin Sacrifice, which throws a grenade.

xBombs clear every symbol except scatters and special wilds, adding +1 to the multiplier each time. Extreme volatility, 31,969x max, and a high 40% hit rate.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
